description: The artist's pictures or videos in Audora's Library, newest first. Search by name, description and the artist's own tags; filter by category (Brand kit, Logo, Cover art, Promo, a platform, Made by Audora, Uploaded, Found online, Stock footage), by the song, album or release a file belongs to, by the artist's own tags, or to files no Promo post uses. Each has a media_asset_id (what update_post takes), its description, tags and links, and a preview link valid for an hour.

album_id.description: Only files linked to this album (from list_albums).

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

categories.description: Only files in every one of these.

not_in_posts.description: true: only files no Promo post uses, whatever the post's status.

release_id.description: Only files linked to this release or to its song or album (from list_releases).

search.description: Words in the file's name, description or the artist's own tags, or the title of the song or album it belongs to.

tags.description: The artist's own tags: only files that carry every one.

track_id.description: Only files linked to this song (from list_tracks).

name: list_media
title: The artist's Library
